legend: Clinical photograph of mucosal melanoma involving the glans penis around the external urethral meatus.

diagnosis: Mucosal melanoma involving the glans penis around the external urethral meatus
legend: The invasive tumour cells are large, pleomorphic, and ovoid to spindled in shape; many include fine intracytoplasmic pigmentation. There are scattered pigment-laden macrophages and lymphocytes in the background. A few scattered single atypical melanocytes are present in the basal portion of the overlying squamous epithelium.
source: Robert V Rawson and Richard AScolyer

source: Robert V Rawson and Richard A Scolyer

diagnosis: Mucosal melanoma involving the glans penis around the external urethral meatus
legend: In situ mucosal melanoma involving the fossa navicularis of the distal urethra. Numerous moderately atypical melanocytes are present involving the basal half of the squamous epithelium.
source: Robert V Rawson and Richard A Scolyer
